lines.port: /* Bottom FIELD/home POKEMON button: open the REAL Party menu.
* This is the same transition as START -> Start Menu -> POKEMON, without
* navigating any menu. It calls the static StartMenuPokemonCallback below,
* so cleanup, CB2_PartyMenuFromStartMenu selection and Party setup are the
* real menu path with identical arguments. No synthetic START/cursor/A is
* ever injected; physical START keeps working untouched.
* Availability reuses FireRed's own field/menu locks (not recreated rules):
* true field callbacks (excludes battle, menus, transitions, Summary, Fly),
* no script, no field-control lock, no fade, not in battle, avatar settled
* and at least one Pokemon (the POKEMON entry itself). Touch one-shot lives
* No pre-fade is performed: TOP holds the field frame from the request (see
* BeginSessionPending port-side), which makes the menu fade redundant, and
* duplicating the async fade-wait would add a task for no visible effect.
* Party exit still returns to the Start Menu via CB2_ReturnToFieldWithOpenMenu,
* exactly as the normal entry does.
